scope: KV only. Preserve accepted structured gold, schema targets, values, IDs and existing exclusions. This is agent review, not additional human gold approval.

policy.keep: Printed field, section, checkbox, row/column label or conventional printed marker identifies the value. Contextual disambiguation and components of a labeled block are allowed.
policy.remove: Key names an inferred role for otherwise unlabeled text; do not require this invented key in KV.
policy.uncertain: Printed semantic label is absent or ambiguous but layout/symbols may identify a pair; withhold from headline KV eligibility pending human choice.
policy.limitations: Visual audit of label eligibility, not a renewed proof of every reference value, crop, table boundary or schema choice. Existing excluded_fields remain excluded even when a label exists.
